topography.project_purpose: Leveraged Farming. Structurally: 179 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 5 ERC4626 vaults, 47 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 37 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, accesscontrolupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
